pending_cmd_sessions.note: initiate_cmd_signature (signature.rs:1618) dispatches a real CCMovelSign network call and a real OTP to a real phone per session; there is no HTTP-reachable or env-configurable seam that substitutes a fake transport for the running binary (AppState.cmd_transport is only ever set by Rust-internal test code that constructs AppState in-process, lib.rs:888). This matches the plan's own CMD non-automatability finding for B1 (plan.md §8 Assumption 3). Rows are therefore written directly at the store layer with the exact pending_cmd_sessions column set (schema.rs:479-491) so the boot-rehydration read path (all_pending_cmd_sessions, lib.rs:1478-1479) sees structurally real data. seed_mode=store_direct_sqlite requires a single-node SQLite-backed instance whose CHANCELA_DATA_DIR is host-reachable; the clustered Postgres-backed perf topology (docker-compose.perf.yml + docker/docker-compose.cluster.yml) is NOT reachable this way today — Postgres is not published to the host and no psycopg dependency exists in this harness. Against that topology this stage must be reported not_measured, never faked. See t57-e3 log.
